slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

facts.fact: Data Landscapers' 54-country review (an AI-assisted compilation) states that rural clinics moved from paper stock and service reporting to DHIS2, used by 99% of public facilities including primary ones; it gives no numerator, denominator or year, so the date is the document's published date, and it does not say the clinics key the data themselves.

Data Landscapers' review states it found no EMR or patient-record system and that records are likely on paper at clinic level with aggregates digitised later; the document gives no date for this, so the date is its published date.

note: Passages file; the Comoros clinic row is the only health passage. It also cites the World Bank COMPASS appraisal (2019) for a DHIS2 upgrade then ongoing, performance-based financing verified against paper registers and cards, and computers in only 14% of facilities; not recorded as a fact because no aspect value is stated.
